Bisou observability

Long image

A

Answer

The PO reads logs, issues and traces in Cloudflare. Healthchecks.io can email the PO about missed or failed cron runs.1

Applies toCloudflare Workers backend

1

Overview

Diagram structure
  • Bisou Worker worker
  • JSON console console
  • Workers Logs logs
  • Workers Issues issues
  • Workers Traces traces
  • Cloudflare dashboard dashboard
  • Healthchecks.io health
  • worker → console · structured events
  • console → logs · indexed fields
  • console → issues · error level
  • worker → traces · runtime spans
  • worker → health · optional heartbeat
  • logs → dashboard
  • issues → dashboard
  • traces → dashboard

Worker entry points are fetch, scheduled and queue. The PO reads the dashboard.2

Application logs

Diagram structure
  • Client client
  • Hono middleware middleware
  • Route handler handler
  • JSON console output
  • Workers Issues issue
  • client → middleware · API request
  • middleware → handler · Dispatch
  • handler → middleware · Throw, build 500
  • middleware → output · api_error + scrubbed stack
  • output → issue · Error-level entry
  • middleware → client · HTTP 500
EventLevelEvent fields
api_errorerror5xx or throw. Route pattern, method, status, durationMs, errorCode, scrubbed stack on throw3
cron_runinfo / errorslot, outcome, durationMs4
heartbeat_failedwarnslot, job outcome, status when available4
queue_batchinfobatchSize, topicCounts, sent, gone, retried, dropped, failed, lagP95Ms5
mail_unavailable, dev_logininfoerrorCode when Resend is unconfigured6
mail_failederrorerrorCode, status when available6
push_queued, push_unavailableinfotopic and count when available
push_failed, push_enqueue_failed, scheduled_note_push_failederrortopic, status or count when available7
cleanup, photo_cleanupinfo / erroroutcome, counts on success2
avatar_rollback_failed, avatar_purge_failed, photo_purge_failederrorcount on photo purge failure

The release identifies the build. Request IDs use a valid cf-ray for HTTP or an invocation UUID for cron and queue.8

The logger allowlists fields and scrubs error messages and stacks. Development alone logs the login code and email when Resend is unconfigured.96

3

Runtime traces

Diagram structure
  • Workers runtime runtime
  • Inbound request inbound
  • Outbound fetch outbound
  • D1 database d1
  • R2 storage r2
  • runtime → inbound · full API URL
  • runtime → outbound · full target URL
  • runtime → d1 · SQL text
  • runtime → r2 · object keys
SpanRecorded data
Inboundurl.full includes API IDs and query strings
Outboundurl.full includes push endpoints and heartbeat URLs
D1db.query.text
R2Object keys can include couple IDs

Sampling is 1 (100%). Logs, traces and Issues share the Free allowance of 0.5 GB/day from 1 December 2026.1011

Invocation logs also record the raw request URL, status and timing.1

4

Alerting

Diagram structure
  • Cron slot scheduled
  • Healthchecks.io healthcheck
  • PO email email
  • Workers Logs workerslog
  • Future Monitors monitors
  • scheduled → healthcheck · base GET or /fail
  • healthcheck → email · failure or late
  • scheduled → workerslog · cron_run
  • workerslog → monitors · later

notes runs every minute. Daily slots run at 07:00, 08:00, 20:00 and 03:00 Vietnam time.12

Configured slots ping the base URL on success or /fail on failure. A missed ping triggers a failure after the 10-minute grace period.41314

Healthchecks.io sends email when the PO enables its email integration. Cloudflare Monitors are deferred.1

Later MonitorExample
Push failuresFailed + gone above 5% in an hour, at least 10 jobs
Push acceptanceBelow 98% over 24 hours
Queue lagBatch p95 above 300,000 ms
Stalled consumerWrites but zero batches over 15 minutes15
